oauth.asks: {name} ({host}) wants to use this Estampes server.
oauth.explain: Enter this server's access key to allow it. Only the server's owner has this key; it only confirms that it is you and is never given to the app.
oauth.findKey: Finding the key: the part after ?key= in the connect URL in the server's startup log, or the access-key file in the storage folder (with Docker: docker compose exec estampes cat /data/access-key).
oauth.onlyIfYou: Enter it only if you just pressed connect yourself (for example Claude's Connect); after signing in you return to the address above. If you don't recognize it, press Deny.
oauth.title: Connect Estampes
oauth.wrongKey: The access key is not correct. Please try again.
